## Flights — Carrying Batteries / Equipment {#sec-flights}

From the FAA's guidance on lithium battery air travel (relevant if you're flying with drone batteries as a passenger):

> "With airline approval, passengers may also carry up to two spare larger lithium ion batteries (exceeding 101–160 Wh) or Lithium metal batteries (exceeding 2–8 grams)."

— [FAA PackSafe: Lithium Batteries](https://www.faa.gov/hazmat/packsafe/lithium-batteries)
